name: virtual-pet-desktop
description: A lightweight cross-platform desktop pet for macOS and Windows.
author: Sheela Rajesh Kumar

scripts.check:js: node --check src/pet-pack.js && node --check src/pet.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check src/care.js && node --check src/packs.js
scripts.check:pets: node scripts/validate-pet-pack.mjs src/pet-packs/puppy && node scripts/validate-pet-pack.mjs src/pet-packs/cat
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:pets && npm run check:fmt && npm run check:rust
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
